timed_out_draft.sql:
WITH exports_2024 AS (
  SELECT SUM(e.amount_usd) AS amount_usd
  FROM export_monthly AS e
  JOIN country AS c ON c.country_code = e.country_code
  WHERE c.country_role = 'COUNTRY'
    AND e.hs_ver = 'HS2022'
    AND e.trade_month BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31'
),
exports_2025 AS (
  SELECT SUM(e.amount_usd) AS amount_usd
  FROM export_monthly AS e
  JOIN country AS c ON c.country_code = e.country_code
  WHERE c.country_role = 'COUNTRY'
    AND e.hs_ver = 'HS2022'
    AND e.trade_month BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT
  y24.amount_usd AS amount_2024_usd,
  y25.amount_usd AS amount_2025_usd,
  y25.amount_usd - y24.amount_usd AS difference_usd
FROM exports_2024 AS y24
CROSS JOIN exports_2025 AS y25
timed_out_draft.summary: 일반 국가의 HS2022 기준 수출액을 연도별로 합산하고, 2025년 금액에서 2024년 금액을 뺍니다.

sql_cases.sql: WITH export_2024 AS (SELECT SUM(e.amount_usd) AS amount_usd FROM export_monthly AS e JOIN country AS c ON c.country_code = e.country_code AND c.country_role = 'COUNTRY' WHERE e.country_code = 'US' AND e.hs6_code = '854232' AND e.hs_ver = 'HS2022' AND e.trade_month BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31'), export_2025 AS (SELECT SUM(e.amount_usd) AS amount_usd FROM export_monthly AS e JOIN country AS c ON c.country_code = e.country_code AND c.country_role = 'COUNTRY' WHERE e.country_code = 'US' AND e.hs6_code = '854232' AND e.hs_ver = 'HS2022' AND e.trade_month BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31') SELECT e24.amount_usd AS export_2024_usd, e25.amount_usd AS export_2025_usd, ROUND((e25.amount_usd - e24.amount_usd) / NULLIF(e24.amount_usd, 0) * 100, 1) AS change_pct FROM export_2024 AS e24 CROSS JOIN export_2025 AS e25 ORDER BY export_2024_usd LIMIT 1000
sentences: 한국의 대미 메모리 집적회로(HS 854232) 수출액은 비교 기간인 2024년에 3억 542만 달러, 대상 기간인 2025년에 3억 7,466만 달러입니다.
2024년을 비교 기간으로 한 2025년 수출액의 변화율은 22.7% 증가입니다.

sql_cases.sql: WITH export_2024 AS (SELECT SUM(es.amount_usd) AS amount_usd FROM export_summary AS es JOIN country AS c ON c.country_code = es.country_code AND c.country_role = 'COUNTRY' WHERE es.country_code = 'US' AND es.hs6_code = '854232' AND es.hs_ver = 'HS2022' AND es.trade_month >= '2024-01-01' AND es.trade_month < '2025-01-01'), export_2025 AS (SELECT SUM(es.amount_usd) AS amount_usd FROM export_summary AS es JOIN country AS c ON c.country_code = es.country_code AND c.country_role = 'COUNTRY' WHERE es.country_code = 'US' AND es.hs6_code = '854232' AND es.hs_ver = 'HS2022' AND es.trade_month >= '2025-01-01' AND es.trade_month < '2026-01-01') SELECT e24.amount_usd AS export_2024_usd, e25.amount_usd AS export_2025_usd, ROUND((e25.amount_usd - e24.amount_usd) / NULLIF(e24.amount_usd, 0) * 100, 1) AS change_pct FROM export_2024 AS e24 CROSS JOIN export_2025 AS e25 ORDER BY export_2024_usd LIMIT 1
sentences: 2024년 비교 기간 한국의 대미 메모리 집적회로(HS 854232) 수출액은 3억 542만 달러(USD)입니다.
2025년 대상 기간 수출액은 3억 7,466만 달러(USD)로, 2024년 비교 기간 대비 22.7% 증가했습니다.
